title: Orbit — Invite Your Team
objective: Members can invite colleagues into the workspace, within limits. Get an account into the workspace that ends up with more privilege than the person who invited it.

verifier.condition: An invitation is accepted and the new account holds a higher role than the member who created that invitation held at the time.

weakness: Invitation creation validates that the requested role exists and refuses to mint owners, but never that the role is no higher than the inviter's own, so a member can create an administrator invitation.
seededData: Workspace 'Northwind Studio' with members alice (member), tess (owner) and ben (viewer). Invitations and new accounts live in memory and reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Workspace member
credentials.note: A regular member of Northwind Studio.

hints: Walk through the whole invitation flow as a normal user first, including what happens when the invited person opens their link.
The form only offers some choices. Whether the server enforces the same choices is something you can test, not assume.
Repeat the invitation request in Repeater and change which role it asks for. The server rejects some values and quietly accepts others — find where the line is.
burpNotes: Do the normal flow once with Burp running — invite someone, then open the link they would receive — so you know what the app sends and what it creates. Then compare what the form lets you pick with what the server will accept.
